mistake_reason: Tool Output Misinterpretation (FM-4.2): The Assistant incorrectly interpreted the tool outputs by comparing numeric totals as strings from the JSON/CSV. Despite FileSurfer repeatedly presenting clear numeric totals showing Wharvton ($1,005,320.50) > Algrimand ($972,880.75), the Assistant chose to use a lexicographic comparison of the string values ("972880.75" vs "1005320.50"), concluding that Algrimand was larger because '9' > '1'. This is a misprocessing of structured tool output and an unsound derivation from unambiguous data, directly leading to the wrong final answer.
